def _integrate_into_parent(value, stack):
    """Integrate a completed value into its parent context."""
    if not stack:
        # Top-level
        return value  # caller sets result and top_done
    parent = stack[-1]

        parent[2].append(value)
        parent[1] = 1  # expecting , or ]
    else:  # object
        key = parent[3]
        parent[2][key] = value
        parent[1] = 3  # expecting , or }
